settings.title: Settings
settings.mccHint: The MinecraftClient.exe the app starts for each account. A change applies to accounts started afterwards.
settings.restoreTabsHint: Brings back the tabs you had open, each one stopped - nothing connects on its own. When off, the app starts with no tabs. Your accounts always come back to the panel - this switch never hides them.
settings.confirmClose: Ask before closing with live connections
settings.confirmCloseHint: Shows a question when closing the window would disconnect the connections that are running. You can also tick “Don't ask again” in the question itself.
settings.sendDelayHint: Pause between accounts when sending to all, to avoid server anti-spam.
settings.logBufferHint: How far back you can scroll in a tab. More lines use more memory.
settings.chatLogHint: Everything each account sees and says is appended to a file for the day, including private messages from other players - those stay on this computer. Login codes and links are never written down.
settings.chatLogDirHint: Inside this folder files are grouped by server and account: server/account/YYYY-MM-DD.log.
settings.chatLogRetentionHint: Older daily files are deleted at startup and once a day. Enter 0 to keep everything.

closeConfirm.title: Close and disconnect?
closeConfirm.message: Closing the app will disconnect {count} connection. | Closing the app will disconnect {count} connections.

addAccount.title: Add account
addAccount.typeMicrosoftHint: E-mail address. Sign in with a code in the browser.
addAccount.typeOfflineHint: Nickname only. Works on servers without premium auth.
addAccount.name: Name
addAccount.noPassword: No password is stored. After adding, pick a server and MCC shows a code to enter at microsoft.com/link.

sidebar.versionHint: Leave empty to let MCC detect it. Set it when the server does not answer the status ping and MCC asks for a version.

loginBanner.title: Sign in to Microsoft
loginBanner.hint: Open the link and enter this code. Minecraft Console Client also opens your browser.
loginBanner.help: The sign-in uses the Microsoft account that is active in your browser, not the login typed here. Signing in with the wrong account? Choose "Use another account" on the Microsoft page, or open the link in a private window or another browser profile. MCC remembers each account's session, so you only sign in once per account.

quickActions.title: Quick actions
quickActions.reloadHint: Reads presets.json from disk again. Use it after editing the file by hand.
quickActions.empty: No actions yet — add the commands you type most, then click them instead of typing.
quickActions.allOff: Every action is switched off — turn one on in the editor.
quickActions.noticeNoneRunning: Nothing is running — the action was not sent.
quickActions.noticeNoActive: Open a connection first — the action was not sent.

presets.title: Quick actions
presets.subtitle: Saved to presets.json
presets.hint: Reordering and deleting are applied after Save.
presets.invalidHint: Every action needs a label and a text.
presets.emptyList: No actions yet. Add the first one below.
presets.textPlaceholder: Text sent to the client, e.g. /send /home
presets.listHint: The switch turns an action on or off (a switch that is off hides the action from the bar). Actions go to the active connection, or to every running one when “Send to all” under the log is ticked.
presets.sendTip: Commands that go to the server must start with /send — MCC treats a leading “/” as its own internal command.

empty.title: No connection open
empty.hint: Use the “Add account” button in the accounts panel header, then click a server on the left.
